title: Save/Load and Progress Persistence
description:
Purpose: Persist player profile: locomotion/comfort settings, difficulty, construct loadouts/unlocks, mission progress. Autosave at key beats; manual save from wrist menu in hub.

Behaviour:
- Data model: CSavedProfile including: locomotion.* (mode, snap_deg, smooth_turn_rate, vignette, horizon_lock), difficulty, constructs.unlocked, constructs.loadout, mastery.points, mission.last_completed, options.accessibility (handedness, captions).
- Autosave on: mission accept, mission complete, unlock purchases, recharge complete, settings change.
- Manual save: from hud_wrist_menu when in hub scenes.
- Load on boot: populate CLocomotionSettings, CMasteryProfile, CConstructTuning defaults, accessibility flags.

APIs:
- settings.get/set(namespace:key, value)
- profile.get/set(path, value)
- save_now(reason)

Acceptance hooks:
- test_save_persistence: After change/restart, states persist.

Assets/scenes: global.
